attempts.summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a three-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb-server-galera 10.11.18 from RHEL10 AppStream, rsync SST). Verified writes from any member propagate to the others (multi-master), verified the cluster stays available and writable when one member is stopped (Primary component, quorum preserved at size=2), and that the stopped member automatically resynchronizes via IST and catches up on all data once restarted. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot_id proof of actual reboot and post-restart cluster/data recovery verification for each.
